final_message:
I fixed the yen receipt bug, and the full test suite now passes (18 of 18).

The cause was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, but yen has no minor unit, so 500 JPY showed as ¥5.00. I added a zero-decimal currency list, currently just `JPY`. Those currencies now print the amount as-is.

`formatMoney` is shared, so invoice lines and cart totals will now also show yen correctly. Nothing else in the repo handles JPY, and no other tests cover it. If you'd rather keep this change to receipts only, tell me and I'll narrow it.
